description: Starts a manual connection of a domain: returns a job_id and the exact records the domain owner creates at their DNS provider, and Cnamio watches the authoritative nameservers for them for up to 72 hours. Changes no DNS.

dnsRecords.description: Records your product needs. host is relative to the zone; placeholders {DOMAIN}, {SUBDOMAIN}, {SLD}, {TLD}; @ is the apex (no CNAME at the apex).

domain.description: The domain or subdomain to connect, without scheme or path.

sandboxToken.description: The auth_token of a sandbox session. Used only when the request carries no credentials; the request then runs against the simulated sandbox provider (no real DNS).

userId.description: Your own user id, echoed in the job and its webhooks.

name: connect_domain
title: Connect a domain (manual records)
